title: launch v1
description: Harbor.Shell to dock, on the control channel: start an app the user chose in the island (docs/adr/0016). The dock starts it as it starts its own items, through Explorer (docs/adr/0009), so the app isn't Harbor Shell's child. Lengths count Unicode characters (code points); control characters are not allowed. Any change to this message bumps v.

kind.description: As in dockItems. app: an AppUserModelID. path: an absolute path to an .exe or .lnk.
